title: Build - Windows
body: If the build scripts could use a cross platform library such as the ones for Node that would be great so this can be built on Windows as well.

comments.body:
Hi @andymac4182 indeed this is something we need to adress by using more native JavaScript rather than shell scripts for build.

May I ask you why do you need to build the project locally? Are you trying to fix some bug or add some new features?

We have pre-built versions available on jsdelivr: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js#from-a-cdn

Let me know

@vvo I was attempting to build it locally as we have a requirement for a geo-search widget that I was going to build and submit back. I am leaving as a separate JS file in my project for the moment but it would be good if this was supported.

Ok definitely something we need to address.

Did you so our google maps widget? https://github.com/instantsearch/instantsearch-googlemaps

I had a look at that. It doesn't fit with what we are looking for.  What we were looking for is find objects within X km using a range slider of IP at the start and eventually using the browser geolocation library for mobile devices. 

After having a look the main items that need to be moved to cross platform allow dev on windows is build.sh and dev.sh files are the ones that look fairly easy to move to either JS or .bat for Windows.

We are not gonna fix this anytime soon. This would require us some good work while we are not at all working on windows at the moment.

I am not saying we will never make it windows compatible, but maybe at somepoint it will be compatible because windows will be happy with the command line.
